chunks: Mu'ammar ibn Khallad asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام:
About storing food for a year, so he said: “I do it myself.”
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Islam to store food for a year?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Mu'ammar ibn Khallad asked Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام about keeping food stored for a year. The Imam عليه السلام answered that he himself did so, indicating the permissibility of such household storage.
